title: Prototype Tiny Tina's Wonderlands inspired VR // for application masters degree
author: Lightartnft
selftext:
Hey everyone

I'm pretty new to this and never made a game. Right now I'm writing a game bible for an application for game design and wanted to build a prototype for a VR Game in the style of Tiny Tina's Wonderlands. 

I used AI for a concept trailer and it turned out pretty good.

Apart from done a two day workshop designing a jump and run level I got no experience developing games whatsoever. 

Just needs to be a simple prototype with dual wielding in a grey box and maybe one enemy.

What are great tools and videos you could recommend to me?

Thanks and Cheers everyone!
